I can do this, but I won’t act until you explicitly confirm the exact target, scope, and operation. Summary and choices below — please reply with the option you want (and confirm the folder name “Employee handbook” is the correct target).

Exact target
- Folder: Docs > Employee handbook

Proposed scope (how I’ll identify “stale drafts” by default)
- Any document in that folder that meets at least one of:
  - Title includes “draft” (case-insensitive) or variants like “v1 draft”
  - Last modified more than 12 months ago
  - Duplicate names where one clearly matches the live handbook and the other is older/unpublished

Proposed action (recommended and reversible)
- Move identified stale drafts into a new folder: Docs > Employee handbook > Archive — Drafts (YYYY-MM-DD).
- This preserves content and history; easy to undo by moving files back.

Alternate action (irreversible unless your Docs offers a trash restore)
- Permanently delete the identified stale drafts.

Who will see the result
- Anyone with access to the Docs > Employee handbook folder (they’ll see fewer items there); the Archive folder will be visible to the same collaborators unless you want different permissions.

What could go wrong
- I might identify and move/delete a file you still need (e.g., a working draft you weren’t treating as stale).
- Links from other docs to moved/deleted files could break or point to the Archive.
- Comments/version history remain with the file but moving/removing could confuse collaborators.

Undoability
- Moving to Archive: reversible (I can move files back).
- Permanent delete: potentially irreversible (dependent on your Docs trash/restore policy). If you want permanent deletion, confirm explicitly.

Please confirm exactly one of these choices (and that “Employee handbook” is the correct folder):
1) Proceed with moving stale drafts (per criteria above) to an Archive folder (recommended, reversible).  
2) Proceed with permanently deleting stale drafts (irreversible).  
3) Don’t take action — instead produce a short list of files I would remove so you can review first.

Reply with the option number to confirm, or change the criteria (e.g., use 6 months instead of 12, only match titles containing “draft”, include subfolders, etc.). I will not proceed until you confirm.
